quotes.text: Shirakawa-go in Gifu Prefecture is one of Japan's snowiest regions. It's famous for its traditional thatched-roof Gassho-style homes. The triangular roofs distribute the weight of heavy snow evenly, and the steep slopes allow residents to remove snow with little effort.

Nobody tells you this but Shirakawa-go gets PACKED by 10am 😅 Take the first bus from Takayama at 7:50 and you'll have the village almost to yourself. Trust me, those thatched roofs hit different in morning mist 🏔️ #JapanTravel #VisitJapan

Today I explored Shirakawa-go, both a UNESCO heritage site full of living history, and the basis of Hinamizawa from the series Higurashi When They Cry! In this thread I'll share all the places I found!

Shirakawa-go is beautiful (it’s MESMERISING covered in snow), the food is great and there are houses and museums open to the public (which are empty because the rest of the tourists don’t seem interested) but yeah: it’s absolutely packed with people (and very rude ones)
